card.name: Old-style prose linking words
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "with" and "have" in 19th-century style scientific or formal prose, often just before an abstract noun or adjective like "great interest" or "valuable acquisition".

modes.label: "of" after a noun
modes.description: The word "of" follows a noun and leads into a quality phrase such as "of great interest".
